answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 16598 Country: AU Title: Asalam valaikum, Can we do qurbani in my daughter's name; she is 16 months old and we have done her aqiqa. Also can we do qurbani in my father-in-law's name who has died 2 years back. Allah hafiz. Question: Asalam valaikum, Can we do qurbani in my daughter's name; she is 16 months old and we have done her aqiqa. Also can we do qurbani in my father-in-law's name who has died 2 years back. Allah hafiz. Answer ID: 16598 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1599/1271/L=1430) Yes, you can perform Qurbani for your daughter and father in law. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
